---
title: "5. Run the analysis: Your own study"
---

## Your task

Open a terminal in your project folder, where `_quarto.yml` is located. Run:

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/02-analyse-example.R data/my-study results/my-study
```

The script checks the inputs first, then writes figures and tables to `results/my-study/`.

## Confirm the run

The main script calls `01-check-inputs.R` before calculating results. It also compares its Shannon calculation with `vegan` for every sample. If an error occurs, resolve it before interpreting outputs from this or an earlier run.

Confirm the input folder is `data/my-study/` and the output folder is `results/my-study/`.

## Inspect the outputs

| File inside `results/my-study/` | Check |
|---|---|
| `tables/alpha-diversity.tsv` | One row per sample; count total, observed features, Shannon |
| `tables/relative-abundance.tsv` | Feature proportions for every sample |
| `tables/composition-display.tsv` | Top eight features and pooled Other |
| `tables/group-summary.tsv` | Group summaries |
| `figures/` | All three PNG figures |
| `session-info.txt` | R and package versions |

## Before continuing

Check that the sample count and group labels agree with your metadata. Open all three figures. Keep the full feature table for diversity calculations; Other is a plotting convenience.
